goal: Build a web calculator with persistent calculation history that is production-ready and deployable at scale.

tasks.objective: Cold-start scaffold: create .gitignore (covering .env*, node_modules/, dist/), .env.example, pre-commit hook blocking .env commits, root README.md, and directory scaffolding (.claude/state, .claude/retrospectives).
tasks.verification: git diff --cached is clean with no .env files; .gitignore covers .env*

tasks.objective: Define the API contract as docs/api-contract.yaml. Endpoints: POST /api/calculate, GET /api/history (paginated), DELETE /api/history/:id, GET /api/health. Include all request/response schemas.
tasks.verification: YAML is valid; all 4 endpoints present with full schemas

tasks.objective: Build the Express/MongoDB backend: evaluate math expressions safely, persist to MongoDB, serve all 4 API endpoints per docs/api-contract.yaml. Apply lessons: express.json limit 10kb, prepare statements at module level, placeholder test script in package.json, helmet+cors+rate-limiting.
tasks.output: backend/ directory with server.js, routes, models, package.json, .env.example
tasks.verification: Server starts cleanly; curl POST /api/calculate returns result + id; GET /api/history returns array; DELETE /api/history/:id returns success

tasks.objective: Build the React/Vite frontend: calculator UI with single-string expression model (not left/op/right state machine), history panel with pagination. Apply lessons: aria-label on all buttons (not data-value), no empty catch blocks, user-visible error states on failed operations.
tasks.output: frontend/ directory with React app, package.json, vite.config.js
tasks.verification: npm run build succeeds; app renders in browser; buttons have aria-label attributes

tasks.objective: Create Dockerfiles (multi-stage) for backend and frontend, plus docker-compose.yml wiring MongoDB + backend + nginx-fronted frontend. Production-ready: health checks, restart policies, resource limits, nginx serving built React static files proxying /api to backend.
tasks.verification: docker-compose up --build starts all 3 services; curl localhost returns React app; curl localhost/api/health returns 200

tasks.objective: Write and run integration + E2E tests against the docker-compose stack. Apply lessons: liveness probe before API tests, run all API contract tests first then Playwright E2E, test required fields as both empty string AND absent, use aria-label selectors not data-value.
tasks.output: tests/ directory with API and E2E test files; green test run
tasks.verification: All tests pass; test output shows API tests ran before Playwright tests
